description: A guided Discord technical-support ticket bot with validated multi-stage reports, persistent drafts, private ticket channels, evidence handling, known issues, incidents, and transcripts.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git ca-certificates rsync
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server
if [ -n "${GIT_REPO}" ]; then
  rm -rf /tmp/ktd-source
  git clone --depth 1 --branch "${GIT_BRANCH}" "${GIT_REPO}" /tmp/ktd-source
  rsync -a --delete --exclude data --exclude logs --exclude config.yaml --exclude .env --exclude .venv /tmp/ktd-source/ /mnt/server/
fi
mkdir -p data/evidence data/transcripts data/backups logs
if [ ! -f config.yaml ] && [ -f config.example.yaml ]; then cp config.example.yaml config.yaml; fi
chmod +x scripts/start.sh scripts/update.sh 2>/dev/null || true
echo "Kingdom Tech Desk installation files prepared. Dependencies install on first Python 3.12 startup."
